ns2:section.sectionText: Long title: History and Techniques of Letterpress Printing. Meets for 2 weeks, Monday through Friday, June 4-15 (begins the last week of SS1 and goes through the the first week of SS2). Class will meet the first day, June 4, in the Soybean Press at the Printing Services Building, 54 E. Gregory, Champaign. The next three days (June 5, 6, 7) the class will meet in the Rare Books & Manuscripts Library (Room 346 Main Library); then the remaining classes will meet back at the Soybean Press. [Eligible course for Special Collections Certificate]. Contact Marianne Steadley for permission to enroll (steadley@uiuc.edu).
